title: The DM funnel stuck in 2015
hook: Setty, on the low table of a rooftop at sunset, to the coach lounging on his phone: You built your [bleep]ing DM funnel in 2015, right?
biais: pertinence pour soi (son funnel, ses mots : « link in bio », « how much »)
aversion à la perte (les leads disparus dans « the inbox void »)

caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build a free AI setter for your DM funnel. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: why a "link in bio" DM funnel loses the leads who already asked.

1. The 2015 funnel is "link in bio and hope": you post, they ask how much, you answer, and that's the last you hear.

2. They didn't say no. Nobody answered their real question or followed up, so they disappeared into the inbox void.

3. They slid into your DMs first, so replying to them isn't chasing, it's answering.

4. Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: he plugs into Manychat, answers the real question in your voice, asks one question at a time, gives your calendar to the right leads and sends up to 3 follow-ups inside the 24-hour window.

The catch: follow-ups only go out inside Meta's 24-hour window, so a lead who went quiet three days ago won't get one. And Setty isn't free once he's live: building and testing are free with no card, then going live starts a 14-day trial at $119/month per live setter.
